findings.description: The location parse stores keepalive_requests into l.keepalive_requests, but the request path closes on ++c.requests>=1000 regardless of the location's value, so keepalive_requests 1 behaves like 1000 and 10000 is capped at 1000. Observed by driving 1001 requests on one connection: the 1000th responds Connection: close. Precondition: none.
findings.title: The connection keep-alive bound is a hardcoded 1000 and the per-location keepalive_requests directive is dead

limitations: All RCE is on the upstream host
This build honours no directive here; verdict is negative-with-one-bound
